registration.requirement: freeze executable, environment, reviewed native event IDs, window, membership collection and global exposure inventory before opening target outcomes; untouched historical editions may be used for conditional validation; prospective claims additionally require registration and persisted forecasts before target series start; no later expansion after metric inspection

candidate.mapProbabilityBaseline: same frozen pre-series map probability without BO transform
candidate.assumption: map probability constant and independent within series; empirical calibration required separately for each format
candidate.historyUpdate: earlier completed verified professional maps from all tiers; no target-series map enters its own feature snapshot

dataset.cutoff: strictly before verified first actual map start; all target-series maps excluded from history
dataset.input: 10 distinct verified identities from expected lineup frozen pre-series, or explicitly reconstructed first-map lineup in conditional cohort
dataset.cohort: conditional reconstructed historical evaluation and prospective issued forecasts reported separately; never claim historical pre-start availability from backfill
dataset.midSeriesSubstitution: record as stratum; never replace first-map lineup with later map lineup or remove a losing series after inspecting results
dataset.membership: complete source-backed map inventory checked against canonical maps, verified format, teams, terminal score, no advantage or technical win; no mandatory second provider; null canonical series.status alone is not rejection
dataset.labels: verified pro map outcomes composed into one series result, kept separate from features
dataset.exposure: old map holdouts, reviewed diagnostics and any exposed sibling exclude entire series from independent target cohort; unknown is not untouched
dataset.development: existing exposed history allowed for development only; not reused as independent release test
dataset.split: chronological whole series; fitted changes require earlier train/calibration/validation blocks and a newly registered untouched test
dataset.denominator: all played series in registered editions and window; explicit exclusions, unavailable inputs and missing membership retained; unknown remote inventory means insufficient

evaluation.baselineGate: paired Brier and natural-log-loss candidate minus constant baseline upper95 strictly below zero; versus unchanged map probability upper95 at most 0.01 for each score
evaluation.stability: sort by verified series start and native key; chronological halves each at least 50 series, Brier delta versus constant <=0.02 and logloss delta <=0.04
evaluation.assessment: one terminal assessment after fixed window and outcome grace; no metric peeking, outcome-driven stopping, or extending window to pass
evaluation.insufficient: do not publish probability; missing BO5 evidence cannot borrow BO3 approval
evaluation.interpretation: engineering pilot thresholds, not a power calculation or guarantee; bootstrap conditional on observed series does not eliminate dependence between shared teams/events
